sources.title: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-GGUF: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-GGUF is a 4 billion parameter causal language model optimized for instruction-following and conversational tasks, maintained by unsloth as a GGUF quantized variant. The model features 36 layers with 32 query attention heads and 8 key-value heads using grouped query attention, achieving native support for 262,144 token context length.
